description: A React component for a doctor interface allowing creation, signing, and storage of prescriptions on the Solana blockchain, with UI elements and wallet interaction.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID string for prescription IDs.

methods.name: addMedRow
methods.description: Adds a new medication entry row.

methods.name: updateMed
methods.description: Updates medication details for a specific row.

methods.name: canonicalMessage
methods.description: Constructs a canonical JSON message representing the current prescription data.

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: Handles wallet connection to obtain wallet public key.

methods.name: onSign
methods.description: Signs the prescription, sends a memo transaction, and stores the prescription locally.
